_scope: Europe (band EU) + Deep time (band CO): events.ts rows, cat-1.json assignments, EU-footprint spreads, polities-eu.json, EU/CO lives and eras from overrides.json. Audit of 25.8.2026 against the founder bar: Essentials at NORMAL = the biggest changes and the major empires; nothing miscategorised.

recat.why: the fall of an empire is regime change, the same class as 'Western Rome falls' (power); as cat war it sits only in the Wars facet and Essentials loses the 1453 epoch boundary

Viking expansion is raiding/migration/settlement across the map — the taxonomy review's reach cluster already took 'Vikings land in Newfoundland'; this puts the start of the Viking age into Essentials where a course covers it
it is the opening act of the Thirty Years' War; in Essentials it reads as a national anecdote, in Wars it sits beside the war it started
the founder's own principle — 'writing is more of a technology topic' — applies verbatim to agriculture; the agriculture spread is already kind technology (sci), the CO event should match

reimp.why: famous but historically inert — it changed nothing; a course on Europe does not need it, DETAILED only
the birth of democracy is a turning point any one-page history of Europe names; belongs at LESS
the Reformation split Western Christendom and redrew the continent — a one-page turning point, not merely course material
symmetric with 'Western Rome falls' (imp 2): the other Rome falls, the conventional end of the Middle Ages
the end of Europe's Cold War division is a one-page turning point on par with 1789 and 1492
a philosopher's lifespan is course material, not a turning point; imp 2 puts the bar into LESS which is reserved for what a one-page history names
same as Plato — keep at NORMAL, out of LESS
his life is course-level; the world-changing artifact (Das Kapital) is its own SC event — the lifespan bar need not sit at LESS
a general European course does not cover Comenius; national-interest figure like Charles University (already imp 5) — DETAILED only keeps Essentials really essential
peak 9 puts Wilhelmine Germany in the essential-at-any-zoom tier with Rome, Britain and Napoleonic France; peak 8 (lvl 2) still ranks it above Austria-Hungary and matches Russian Empire

flags.issue: STRUCTURAL: facetOf() sends every cat=war mark to the Wars facet, so the default spine's EU Essentials at NORMAL omits both World Wars and Alexander's conquests — the region's biggest changes fail the founder's NORMAL bar. Recat would be a lie (they are wars). Needs an escape hatch, e.g. imp<=2 wars also pass in ess, or the spine ships eu-war
same structural gap as World War I — absent from EU Essentials at any detail because cat war owns it exclusively

regionOf(34.5, 38.0) classifies the Fertile Crescent origin as EU (the EU box starts at lat 34), so the Farming spread lands in Europe · Science; it is the MidEast's signature contribution and belongs to ME. regionOf's box is too coarse — spreads need an explicit region field
same regionOf box error: first footprint (39.0, 33.0) is Anatolia, classified EU; the spread's story is Near Eastern
same regionOf box error: first footprint (39.6, 34.6) is Hattusa, Anatolia, classified EU
duplicate representation: the event zone (-1600..-1100) and polity:mycenaean-greece cover the identical span and subject; cat-1 already carries flag:true — drop the event zone or bind them same-as
